notes.title: Big update from Luden.io
notes.content:
Hello all :) Oleg from Luden.io is here. I can't wait to tell you that today our new game Learning Factory finally becomes available. We'll be super happy if you stop by and join us on this adventure of [url=https://blog.luden.io/meet-learning-factory-8d5fd27dac7e]making the best educational game we can[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150090/Learning_Factory/

Please don't hesitate to drop me a line in [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord[/url] or privately via oleg.chumakov@luden.io. I am always happy to talk :)

notes.title: Summer Sale begins
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3oKIPulR03llnTNR1C/giphy.gif[/img]

Hello, guys! 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/588560/VRobot/

Thank you for playing our game! We are glad to inform you about Steam Summer Sale of another our game, [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/588560/VRobot/]VRobot[/url].  That’s the game about the huge robot who saves the planet from other robots. You can relax after the working week and crash some building using Transformer’s Sword, Tractor Beam, Tornado Maker or bare hands. And all this pleasure with 50 percent discount!

Hope that information is useful for you!
Cheers!
